title: Nasruddin Tale 182: The Mirror on the Wall
summary: A neighbor came to complain about the vices and flaws of everyone in the village....
full_text:
A neighbor came to complain about the vices and flaws of everyone in the village.

Nasruddin turned a large bronze mirror toward the man: "Here is the supreme tribunal! Look into this glass, reform the rogue you see standing there, and the entire village will suddenly become ninety percent more virtuous!"
moral: Look into the mirror of conscience before passing judgment on others.
